prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1382; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting neck and back pain with stiffness and limited range of motion in the cervical and lumbar regions. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the crash, and the presenting complaints fit the pattern expected from this type of impact. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the neck and low back. No prior injury to these body areas is known from the patient history. Care was delivered over eleven visits and followed a typical course, including manual therapy, stretching, and a graded home exercise program. Symptoms steadily improved, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as the patient progressed toward discharge. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise and activity as tolerated.
